largest_gap: Continuous grounded landform and material depth: the build still exposes broad hard-edged shoulder polygons and repeated low-poly grass/tree clumps, while the bar has smooth rolling terrain, dense layered vegetation, and natural contact shading.
secondary_gaps: Golden and night states are materially flatter and less readable: weak warm exposure and headlight/local-light response versus the bar's saturated low sun and road illumination.
Cockpit and vehicle geometry remain visibly stylized and occupy a different framing/read from the authored reference vehicle interiors.
Wide vista lacks the bar's water-backed composition and multi-distance ridge scale; shadows on the elevated road are overly heavy.

shots.note: Bar opens into a broad lake-backed valley with smooth grass and authored vehicle; build has readable road but hard shoulder planes and stamped clumps.
Bar has saturated warm low sun, long controlled shadows, and cohesive fields; build is washed out with a dark road shadow and flat verge.
Semantic season/biome mismatch (spring dawn build versus terrestrial winter bar); even with season N/A, bar has substantially richer layered relief, snow/contact materials, and atmospheric depth.
Bar's lake edge, headlights, road markings, and exposure remain readable; build is very dark with weak local illumination and flatter scenery.
Bar cockpit has convincing interior/road framing and natural hillside; build dashboard is blocky and consumes more of the frame while terrain remains low-poly.
Bar delivers a clean lake-backed mountain vista and contouring road; build's elevated road is legible but lacks water and has heavy canopy shadows and repetitive ground cards.

verdict_text: Independent fresh seven-shot A/B review. The official bar wins all seven quality comparisons; blind identity guesses are 7/7. The current road-aware terrain refinement improves continuity enough to keep every frame readable, but the largest material gap remains continuous natural ground/vegetation integration and multi-distance landform depth. season_winter correctly uses terrestrial sr_13; chase_dawn is explicitly marked semantically incomparable on season/biome rather than granting season credit.
